# Social Preview Image Setup

## For Repository Owner (Jeet)

### GitHub Social Preview Image

1. Go to https://github.com/Jeet1511/telo3/settings
2. Scroll to "Social preview"
3. Upload an image (1280x640px recommended)

### Recommended Image Content:

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                                            ║
║                    🚀 Telo3                                ║
║                                                            ║
║        Elite AI Development Framework                      ║
║                                                            ║
║    Transform Vibe Coders → Systematic Engineers           ║
║                                                            ║
║  ✓ 6-Document System    ✓ 80% Token Savings              ║
║  ✓ 11 Quality Frameworks ✓ Universal (Any AI + Any IDE)  ║
║  ✓ Security & Privacy    ✓ Open Source                    ║
║                                                            ║
║              Created by Jeet (@Jeet1511)                   ║
║                                                            ║
║         github.com/Jeet1511/telo3                         ║
║                                                            ║
╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
```

### Design Specifications:

- **Size:** 1280x640px (2:1 ratio)
- **Format:** PNG or JPG
- **Max file size:** 1MB
- **Colors:** 
  - Background: Dark (#0a0a0a) or gradient
  - Text: White (#ffffff) or primary color
  - Accent: Blue/Cyan for tech feel
- **Font:** Clean, modern sans-serif (Inter, Roboto, or similar)

### Quick Design Options:

**Option 1: Use Canva (Free)**
1. Go to canva.com
2. Custom size: 1280x640px
3. Use template or create from scratch
4. Export as PNG

**Option 2: Use Figma (Free)**
1. Create 1280x640px frame
2. Design following specs above
3. Export as PNG

**Option 3: AI Generation**
```
Prompt for AI image generator:
"Create a modern tech banner 1280x640px for 'Telo3' - an AI development 
framework. Dark background, clean typography, includes: Telo3 logo, 
tagline 'Transform Vibe Coders to Systematic Engineers', icons for 
security/performance/quality, github.com/Jeet1511/telo3, 
professional developer tool aesthetic"
```

### After Creating Image:

1. Save as `social-preview.png`
2. Upload to GitHub repository settings
3. Verify preview at: https://github.com/Jeet1511/telo3

### Where This Image Appears:

- GitHub repository page
- When sharing on Twitter/X
- When sharing on LinkedIn
- When sharing on Discord
- GitHub search results
- Open Graph meta tags

### OpenGraph Meta Tags

Already configured in SKILL-METADATA.json:
```json
"seo": {
  "image": "/social-preview.png"
}
```

### Test Your Social Preview:

- **Twitter Card Validator:** https://cards-dev.twitter.com/validator
- **Facebook Debugger:** https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/
- **LinkedIn Inspector:** https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/

## Alternative: README Banner

If you don't want to create a custom image, you can use a README banner instead:

Add to top of README.md:
```markdown
<div align="center">
  <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/1200x300/0a0a0a/ffffff?text=Telo3+-+Elite+AI+Development+Framework" alt="Telo3 Banner" />
</div>
```

Or use a badge generator:
- https://shields.io/
- https://forthebadge.com/
- https://badgen.net/

---

**Note:** This file is for documentation only. The actual image needs to be created and uploaded through GitHub repository settings.
